headline: Local Man Detained By Police For Carrying ‘Excessively Suspicious’ PowerPoint Presentation To Business Meet
body:
Q: Mr. Sharma, the authorities held you for six hours yesterday. What exactly were they so worried about in your laptop bag?

A: It was a misunderstanding, really. I was heading to a regional trade summit and had a slide deck on ‘Synergistic Growth Projections.’ The sub-inspector saw the transition animation—it was a ‘Dissolve’ effect—and insisted I was trying to make state secrets vanish into thin air.

Q: They claimed the detention was for ‘pre-emptive vibe stabilization.’ Did they actually interrogate you about the content of your Q4 report?

A: Precisely. They kept asking why my pie charts were skewed towards the 'Aggressive Expansion' quadrant. They seemed convinced that any font larger than 24-point bold constitutes an unauthorized call to assembly. I tried to explain it was just standard corporate branding, but they confiscated my mouse as a ‘blunt force weapon’ and demanded I apologize to the projector screen.

Q: How did you eventually secure your release?

A: I had to print out the entire presentation on dot-matrix paper and show them the ‘Thank You’ slide as proof of my peaceful intentions. They let me go only after I promised to switch my default template to something more ‘calming,’ like a soft-grey gradient.
